reviewer: independent second pass (fresh context, PDF-first; parser output not used to justify an annotation)
method: Every item was re-opened as a standalone crop of the source PDF before comparing against the annotation. Bbox, header depth, header text, column and row count, merges and roles were checked against the printed datasheet; parser output was consulted last, only to classify residual mismatches as gold ambiguity or parser gap.

baseline_fp_review.evidence: Baseline emits 5.783 predictions per gold table on average (max 25) and fragments every page's ruled boxes; the same gold annotations yield 0 in-scope FP and 0 negative FP after the five-layer rewrite, without any gold bbox or label being relaxed.

open_ambiguities.text: P04-T01 and P70 split the partial Either-input band into two condition columns; P37 merges the same band. Gold is internally inconsistent. Both conventions were kept frozen this round to preserve before/after comparability; a future annotation revision should pick one.
The table prints no header over its test-condition column; the parser reports UNKNOWN. Inferring a role from an empty cell would be a guess.
Gold calls the leading SYSREF_POS bit-field column VALUE; it behaves like a symbol column. Parser reports SYMBOL.
Single-row register bit-field diagrams look table-like but are excluded from the data-table scope by design; the parser agrees.
Structure verified; cell text was spot-checked, not verified cell by cell.
